impact.text: First depositor instantly controls ~100 % of shares for negligible cost.

precondition_sources.text: The HypoVault constructor pre-sets totalSupply = 1 000 000 while the vault owns zero underlying assets.
Before the first fulfilment, computeNAV() == assetsDeposited, so totalAssets == 1.

intent_sources.text: The vault should start with zero supply and mint shares only when assets exist.
For the very first deposit, sharesReceived should equal assetsToFulfill.
